title: On gravitational collapse and integrable singularities
summary: Schwarzschild black holes are expected to emerge as the end states of the classical gravitational collapse from non-singular configurations. After integrable curvature singularities appear, the interior geometry can be modelled to exhibit a transition, called ``Minkowski breaking'', when the inner horizon disappears, before all matter collapses into the central singularity.
